title: How to Craft GOD-TIER Flat Attack Rarity Rings! | Step-by-Step Guide
creator: XTheFarmerX

base.name: unstated

otherMods: magic ring (one prefix plus one suffix): a T1 or T2 elemental flat attack damage prefix (not physical) plus either a resistance suffix or an open suffix; 'tier one, tier one' / 'tier one, tier two' at 1:01–1:13 means flat plus suffix, and Opulence then makes 'triple tier ones' (1:54–1:58); same base described in _sSjC5LX_Ck 0:21–0:53

priceClaim.quote: we bought the base for 60x, right?

base.quote: you really have to start on a good magic base. You don't need to have tier one, tier one

steps.quote: So we throw on the opulences on these rings. It's guaranteed tier one rarity.
steps.note: Essence of Opulence gives T1 rarity after the rarity nerfs (1:27–1:32); the whole deterministic part cost about half a div (1:56–2:00).

steps.quote: omen of dextral exaltation and then omen of catalyzing exaltation. So these two together just make it so this targets the suffix.
steps.note: Catalyst matches the wanted stat: fire resistance shown first (Xoph's inferred from 'let's do fire resistance'), then lightning ('Ech's' normalised to Esh's, 4:56). Greater Exalted Orb is the cheaper alternative (greater guarantees T5 or better, perfect T3 or better on fire res; 2:55–3:04). Cold res has no perfect-exalt breakpoint so a cold catalyst with perfect is poor value (4:26–4:35). Attribute catalysts for attribute rolls (2:42–2:46).

target.text: a physical flat (or any good prefix)

steps.quote: the plan is the exact same as the last step except this time we don't need to use the dextral exaltation cuz we have prefixes.
steps.note: Captions say 'Fizz' catalyst, read as the Physical catalyst (Uul-Netol's). Catalysing omen kept because 'exact same as the last step'; no other omen as suffixes are full. Reasoning: T1 physical weight 400 vs 200 for each elemental flat (5:34–5:49).

target.text: flat attack damage or rarity (life acceptable, percentage damage weak)

steps.quote: Add collar bones to this. So, one thing to consider is using a preserved collarbone versus using an ancient collar bone.
steps.note: Applied on the rings that hit. Ancient is called 2x the value of preserved; compare cost of preserved + echo + Omen of Light against ancient + echo (9:15–9:31).

missHandling.trigger: physical slam misses and the ring counts as bricked (base resale about 20x or less)
missHandling.quote: grab a sinestral crystallization and then you can grab a essence of the abyss.
missHandling.note: Omen of Sinistral Crystallisation + Essence of the Abyss: removes a random prefix (50/50 which) and turns it into a Mark of the Abyssal Lord, then a collarbone makes it a desecration; the Physical catalyst is reapplied for a second try (8:44–8:56). The creator's own try lost the 50/50. He only recommends it if the item is truly bricked (8:22–8:26).

qualityPath.orderNote: Matching-stat catalyst quality is put on before each catalysing exalt (resistance catalyst for the suffix step, Physical catalyst before the prefix step); the catalysing omen consumes it.

caveats: No homogenising omens: 'there's no more homogs in this game anymore', so the start needs a good magic base and the craft is not deterministic (0:40–0:50).
Avoid physical-flat bases so the Physical flat can be hit later; T1 lightning, cold and fire flats weight 200 each, T1 physical 400 (5:34–6:49). Weights are read off a tool, not counted.
Perfect exalt breakpoint: fire and lightning res skip T4, cold res does not (4:19–4:35).
Desecrate settle stats: flats and rarity are premium, life decent, percentage damage weak, mana, evasion, accuracy and chaos damage are bricks (9:39–10:31).
Result tradeoff: Reaver catalyst gives the attack tag but is far pricier than the matching-element or Physical catalyst (6:10–6:32).
unresolved: Which catalyst the first fire-resistance slam used: the transcript says only 'corresponding' catalyst and 'fire resistance'; Xoph's is inferred.

Whether the collarbone is applied to a free prefix or to the slot created by the Physical slam is not clear: the final ring is 'triple flat with rarity' after a collarbone on a ring that already had a prefix slam.
'Fizz' is read as the Physical catalyst; the '1.1x' and '12x' prices (6:13–6:19) are exalts and are recorded as material_price claims.
Number of attempts and how many rings were attempted overall is not stated beyond the three rings shown.
Patch and league week at upload are not stated.
